labelling_rule:
Label rule (written 16 Oct 2026, before these rows were run):
R1 retraction of Lancet HCQ DOI 10.1016/S0140-6736(20)31180-6 → block.
R2 known EoC (Khan 2003) or known 2-hop to it (Healthline cinnamon, Everyday Health cinnamon, Allen/Deyno/CTIM/Moridpour/Cochrane) → warn.
R3 public-page HTML that contains those same identifiers → warn.
R4 public-page HTML with no DOI/PMID/PMCID → pass (no chain to inspect).
R5 public-page HTML with other scholarly ids that are not known flags → pass pending a publisher notice; relabel if a counted path appears.
R6 no verifiable source → warn (no_sources).
R7 depth 1 on a review that only reaches Khan at hop 2 → pass.

checker.name: direct_doi_crossref
checker.rule: Extract DOIs and doi.org URLs literally present in the draft text and URL list. Look each DOI up on Crossref updated-by. Retraction/withdrawal/removal → block. Expression of Concern → warn. Corrections, errata, and new_version are not flags. Consumer pages are not fetched. Unresolved DOIs and drafts with no DOI pass.

metrics.rule: Binary positive class is warn or block. Exact match is the three-way decision. Infra rows are excluded from scored metrics.
